import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.environment_shell import get_environment_shell_builder

class Hou_Mcp_Build_Shell(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_build_shell"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("environment",            "string", widget_type="text", default="western_room")
        self.add_input("structural_assets_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_output("shell_json")
        self.add_output("gate_json")
        self.add_output("audit_json")
        self.add_output("review_json")
        self.add_output("environment_ready", "bool")
        self.add_output("production_ready",  "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        environment = (inputs.get("environment") or "western_room").strip()
        raw_assets  = (inputs.get("structural_assets_json") or "[]").strip()
        try:
            structural_assets = json.loads(raw_assets) if raw_assets else []
            if not isinstance(structural_assets, list):
                structural_assets = []
        except Exception:
            structural_assets = []

        try:
            result = get_environment_shell_builder().build(environment, structural_assets)
            return {
                "shell_json":        json.dumps(result.shell.to_dict()  if result.shell  else {}, sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "gate_json":         json.dumps(result.gate.to_dict()   if result.gate   else {}, sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "audit_json":        json.dumps(result.audit.to_dict()  if result.audit  else {}, sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "review_json":       json.dumps(result.review.to_dict() if result.review else {}, sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "environment_ready": result.shell.environment_ready if result.shell else False,
                "production_ready":  result.review.production_ready if result.review else False,
                "exec_out":          True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_build_shell failed: {exc}")
            return {"shell_json": "{}", "gate_json": "{}", "audit_json": "{}", "review_json": "{}", "environment_ready": False, "production_ready": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Build_Shell
